templateDescriptions.linux-inventory: Extended Linux inventory: users, recent logins, services, packages, listening ports, firewall rules, and security log sample.
templateDescriptions.linux-compliance: Detailed Linux compliance : SSH, passwords/PAM, accounts, file permissions, firewall, kernel hardening, auditd, MAC, patching, and more.
templateDescriptions.windows-inventory: Extended Windows inventory: system details, local users/admins, services, disks, installed updates, and Security event sample.
templateDescriptions.windows-compliance: Detailed Windows compliance : local accounts, password policy, firewall, updates, Defender, audit, UAC, BitLocker, and more.
templateDescriptions.network-inventory: Extended network inventory: version, interfaces, hostname, AAA/users, logging config, and recent log buffer sample.
templateDescriptions.network-compliance: Remote baseline checks for network devices: hostname, AAA, and SSH hardening (matches config parser rules).
templateDescriptions.network-remediation: Collect current AAA/SSH state and output suggested remediation CLI for download and manual apply.
templateDescriptions.connectivity-check: Quick host reachability test using ansible ping.

templateDescriptionsFast.linux-inventory: Fast Linux inventory: core host identity, users/services sample, listening ports, and a short security log excerpt.
templateDescriptionsFast.linux-compliance: Fast Linux compliance: essential SSH, firewall, auditd, and time sync checks.
templateDescriptionsFast.windows-inventory: Fast Windows inventory: core system details, users/services sample, disks, and a short Security event sample.
templateDescriptionsFast.windows-compliance: Fast Windows compliance: admins, firewall, updates, Defender, and UAC.
templateDescriptionsFast.network-inventory: Fast network inventory: version, interface sample, hostname, and short log buffer excerpt.
templateDescriptionsFast.network-compliance: Fast network compliance: hostname and AAA sample lines.
templateDescriptionsFast.network-remediation: Fast remediation prep: suggested hardening CLI commands only.
